castra-menu.js::<div class=\"note\">Null: Nog geen helden. No heroes yet: look for traces during the hunt and talk to them.
Geen opdracht. No active task: talk to a hero in the regions.
Greetings, guest {naam}! I am Aeneas. Enemies in the forest are a nuisance. Defeat three enemies in the forest and you will have my help.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt drie vijanden ve: Excellent! You have defeated three enemies.
en::Goed! Verdedig nu het kamp. Win het: Good! Now defend the camp. Win the first battle.
en::Je hebt het kamp verdedigd! Ik dank: You have defended the camp! Thank you.
en::Waarom zou ik met je meegaan, leider: Why should I go with you, leader {naam}?
en::Omdat ik vrienden bescherm en het ka: Because I protect my friends and defend the camp.
Because I don't want to fight.
en::Ik ga met je mee, leider {naam}!: I will go with you, leader {naam}!
en::Troje is gevallen. Ik zoek een nieuw: Troy has fallen. I am looking for a new homeland.
en::Mijn vader is oud. Ik draag hem op m: My father is old. I carry him on my shoulders.
en::De goden helpen mij. Ik zeil naar It: The gods help me. I sail to Italy.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Romul: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Romulus. I am founding a new city. Defeat four enemies in the field and you will help me.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt vier vijanden ve: Excellent! You have defeated four enemies.
en::Goed! Verdedig nu de Latijnse weg. W: Good! Now defend the Latin Road. Win the second battle.
en::Je hebt de weg verdedigd! Ik dank je: You have defended the road! Thank you.
en::Rome zal een grote stad worden. Wat: Rome will become a great city. What do you do for the city?
I build walls and lead soldiers.
en::Een wolvin heeft mij gevoed. Ik heb: A she-wolf fed me. I have a brother, Remus.
I am founding the city on the Palatine.
en::Waar sticht Romulus de stad?: Where does Romulus found the city?
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Horat: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Horatius. Enemies are coming to the Tiber. Defeat three enemies at the Tiber.
Excellent! You have saved the bridge.
en::Goed! Verdedig nu de weg. Win het tw: Good! Now defend the road. Win the second battle.
en::Ik verdedig de brug. Verdedig jij de: I defend the bridge. Will you defend the bridge too?
en::De Sublicische brug ligt over de Tib: The Sublician Bridge spans the Tiber. Enemies are coming.
en::Alleen verdedig ik de brug. Mijn vri: I defend the bridge alone. My friends are tearing the bridge down.
en::Ik spring in de Tiber. Ik zwem naar: I jump into the Tiber. I swim to the bank.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Cloel: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Cloelia. I was a hostage, but I escaped from the camp. Defeat three enemies at the Tiber.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt de Tiber verdedi: Excellent! You have defended the Tiber.
en::Goed! Val nu Ardea aan. Win het derd: Good! Now attack Ardea. Win the third battle.
You have defeated Ardea! Thank you.
en::Ik steek de Tiber te paard over. Ben: I cross the Tiber on horseback. Are you brave too?
Yes, I am afraid of nothing.
No, I am afraid of everything.
en::Ik was gijzelaar bij de vijanden. 's: I was a hostage among the enemy. I escape at night.
en::Ik pak een paard en steek de Tiber o: I take a horse and cross the Tiber.
en::De Romeinen prijzen mij. Mijn standb: The Romans praise me. My statue stands on the road.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Muciu: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Mucius. There are enemies on the road. Defeat three enemies on the road.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt de weg schoongem: Excellent! You have cleared the road.
en::Ik houd mijn rechterhand in het vuur: I hold my right hand in the fire. Am I afraid of pain, perhaps?
No, because I love my homeland.
Yes, I am afraid of pain.
I am going to the enemy king. I want to kill him.
I put my right hand into the fire.
en::Wat legt Mucius in het vuur?: What does Mucius put into the fire?
en::De koning laat mij gaan. Mijn naam i: The king lets me go. My name is Scaevola.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Camil: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Camilla. I live in the forest. Defeat four enemies in the forest.
Excellent! You have saved the forest.
en::Ik ren snel en schiet pijlen. Wat do: I run fast and shoot arrows. What do you do?
en::Ik ren snel en vecht tegen de vijand: I run fast and fight the enemies.
I sleep in a little house.
en::Ik hou van de bossen. Ik ren met de: I love the forests. I run with the horses.
en::Ik schiet pijlen en versla de vijand: I shoot arrows and defeat the enemies.
en::Mijn vader heeft mij in het bos groo: My father raised me in the forest.
en::Waar bracht de vader Camilla groot?: Where did Camilla's father raise her?
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Hercu: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Hercules. There are lions on the mountain. Defeat four enemies on the mountain.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt de berg schoonge: Excellent! You have cleared the mountain.
en::Goed! Nu doen we de eerste labor. Wi: Good! Now we do the first labour. Win the battle.
en::Je hebt de labor volbracht! Ik dank: You have completed the labour! Thank you.
en::Ik doe veel opdrachten. Werk jij ook: I do many tasks. Do you work hard too?
en::Ik versla de Nemeïsche leeuw. Zijn h: I defeat the Nemean lion. His skin covers me.
en::Hoeveel opdrachten voert Hercules ui: How many tasks does Hercules carry out?
I defeat the Hydra in the swamp.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Perse: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Perseus. The Gorgons live by the coast. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Excellent! You have saved the coast.
en::Goed! Nu gaan we Medusa aanvallen. W: Good! Now we attack Medusa. Win the first battle.
en::Je hebt het gevecht gewonnen! Ik dan: You have won the battle! Thank you.
I can carry Medusa's head. Will you help me?
Yes, I'm happy to help you.
en::Nee, ik ben bang voor Medusa!: No, I am afraid of Medusa!
Medusa has snakes on her head.
en::Wat heeft Medusa op haar hoofd?: What does Medusa have on her head?
en::Ik heb gevleugelde sandalen. Ik vlie: I have winged sandals. I fly through the air.
I rescue Andromeda and defeat Medusa.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben These: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Theseus. The Minotaur is in the labyrinth. Defeat four enemies in the city.
Excellent! You have saved the city.
en::Goed! Nu gaan we het labyrint in. Wi: Good! Now we enter the labyrinth. Win the second battle.
en::Je hebt het labyrint verslagen! Ik d: You have defeated the labyrinth! Thank you.
en::Ik zoek de Minotaurus in het labyrin: I am looking for the Minotaur in the labyrinth. Will you come with me?
Yes, I follow you and I rescue the brothers.
No, I am afraid of the labyrinth.
The Minotaur lives in the labyrinth.
en::Ik versla de Minotaurus en ga uit he: I defeat the Minotaur and leave the labyrinth.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Atala: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Atalanta. I hunt in the olive groves. Defeat four enemies in the olive groves.
en::Versla vijanden in de olijfgaarden!: Defeat enemies in the olive groves!
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt de olijfgaarden: Excellent! You have saved the olive groves.
en::Goed! Nu zoeken we het everzwijn. Wi: Good! Now we look for the boar. Win the battle.
en::Ik ben de snelste. Ren jij snel?: I am the fastest. Do you run fast?
en::Ik ren snel, maar ik verslaag jou ni: I run fast, but I don't beat you.
en::Ik versla het Calydonische everzwijn: I defeat the Calydonian boar with arrows.
en::In het hardlopen versla ik alle mann: In running I beat all the men.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Jason: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Jason. I am building the ship Argo. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Excellent! You have freed the coast.
Good! Now we look for the Golden Fleece. Win the second battle.
en::Ik zeil voor het gouden vlies. Heb j: I sail for the Golden Fleece. Do you have a ship?
en::Ik heb een schip en dappere zeeliede: I have a ship and brave sailors.
I have no ship, but I am afraid.
The Golden Fleece is in Colchis.
en::Medea helpt mij. Ze laat de draak sl: Medea helps me. She puts the dragon to sleep.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Medea: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Medea. I am looking for herbs. Defeat three enemies in the olive grove.
en::Versla vijanden in de olijfgaard!: Defeat enemies in the olive grove!
Excellent! The olive grove is free.
en::Goed! Nu help ik Jason. Win het twee: Good! Now I help Jason. Win the second battle.
I gather herbs in the forest.
en::Ik laat de draak slapen. Jason pakt: I put the dragon to sleep. Jason takes the fleece.
en::Wie laat de draak slapen?: Who puts the dragon to sleep?
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Daeda: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Daedalus. I build machines. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
en::Goed! Nu bouw ik het labyrint. Win h: Good! Now I build the labyrinth. Win the first battle.
Because I am afraid of machines.
I build the labyrinth for Minos.
I make wings from feathers and wax.
en::Waarvan zijn de vleugels gemaakt?: What are the wings made of?
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Prome: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Prometheus. I gave fire to humankind. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Good! Now I resist Jupiter. Win the first battle.
en::Jupiter straft mij. Waarom zou ik me: Jupiter punishes me. Why should I go with you?
Because I am afraid of Jupiter.
en::Een adelaar eet mijn lever. Hercules: An eagle eats my liver. Hercules frees me.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Achil: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Achilles. The Trojans are fighting in front of the walls. Defeat four enemies in the field.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt het veld schoong: Excellent! You have cleared the field.
Good! Now attack the walls of Troy. Win the battle.
en::Je hebt de muren verslagen! Ik dank: You have conquered the walls! Thank you.
en::Mijn woede is groot. Waarom vecht ji: My anger is great. Why do you fight?
en::Mijn moeder is een godin. Ze heet Th: My mother is a goddess. Her name is Thetis.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Hecto: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Hector. I defend Troy. Defeat four enemies in front of the walls.
en::Versla vijanden voor de muren!: Defeat enemies in front of the walls!
Excellent! You have saved the walls.
en::Goed! Verdedig nu de muren van Troje: Good! Now defend the walls of Troy. Win the battle.
en::Je hebt de muren verdedigd! Ik dank: You have defended the walls! Thank you.
en::Ik vecht voor mijn vaderland. Hou ji: I fight for my homeland. Do you love your homeland too?
en::Ja, ik hou van mijn vaderland en mij: Yes, I love my homeland and my family.
en::Mijn vaderland betekent niets voor m: My homeland means nothing to me.
en::Priamus is mijn vader. Hij is de kon: Priam is my father. He is the king of Troy.
en::Wie is de koning van Troje?: Who is the king of Troy?
In front of the walls I fight Achilles.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Odyss: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Odysseus. The Greek ships lie on the coast. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt de schepen gered: Excellent! You have saved the ships.
Good! Now we build the wooden horse. Win the second battle.
en::Je hebt het paard gebouwd! Ik dank j: You have built the horse! Thank you.
en::Ik ben sluw. Ik maak plannen. Wie ma: I am cunning. I make plans. Who makes plans with you?
I am afraid of the horse.
en::Ik bouw het houten paard. Soldaten v: I build the wooden horse. Soldiers hide inside the horse.
en::Ik wil naar huis terugkeren. Penelop: I want to return home. Penelope is waiting for me.
en::Hoeveel ogen heeft Polyphemus?: How many eyes does Polyphemus have?
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Penth: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Penthesilea. I fight at the Scamander. Defeat three enemies at the Scamander.
en::Uitstekend! Je hebt de Scamander ger: Excellent! You have saved the Scamander.
en::Goed! Nu helpen we Troje. Win het tw: Good! Now we help Troy. Win the second battle.
You have helped Troy! Thank you.
I am the queen of the Amazons. Do you fight for Troy?
No, I fight for the enemies.
I have a bow and arrows.
en::Ik vecht met Achilles, maar ik word: I fight Achilles, but I am defeated.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Cassa: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Cassandra. I see danger. Defeat three enemies in front of the walls.
en::Goed! Nu red ik Troje. Win het eerst: Good! Now I save Troy. Win the first battle.
en::Niemand gelooft mij. Geloof jij mij?: Nobody believes me. Do you believe me?
en::Ik zie het houten paard. Er is gevaa: I see the wooden horse. There is danger!
en::Apollo gaf mij een gave, maar nieman: Apollo gave me a gift, but nobody believes me.
en::Mijn vader is koning. Hij heet Priam: My father is a king. His name is Priam.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Circe: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Circe. I love herbs and wolves. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
en::Goed! Nu help ik Odysseus. Win het t: Good! Now I help Odysseus. Win the second battle.
en::Ik verander mensen in zwijnen. Waaro: I turn people into pigs. Why should I go with you?
I live on the island of Aeaea.
en::Ik verander de maten van Odysseus in: I turn Odysseus' companions into pigs.
en::Wie verandert Circe in zwijnen?: Who does Circe turn into pigs?
en::Ik heb kruiden. Odysseus is niet ban: I have herbs. Odysseus is not afraid of me.
Aeacus turned ants into people. The Myrmidons follow Achilles.
en::Cadmus zaait drakentanden. Gewapende: Cadmus sows dragon's teeth. Armed men rise from the ground.
en::Een wolvin voedt Romulus en Remus. D: A she-wolf nurses Romulus and Remus. The wolf of Mars is sacred.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik zoek ster: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am looking for strong soldiers.
en::Laat mij een sterke soldaat zien (mi: Show me a strong soldier (at least 22 impetus) and capture two enemies.
en::Heb een soldaat met minstens 22 impe: Have a soldier with at least 22 impetus.
en::Uitstekend, leider {naam}! Hier is j: Excellent, leader {naam}! Here is your reward.
en::Ach, gast {naam}! Mijn ring is verdw: Oh, guest {naam}! My ring is gone.
en::Zoek mijn ring op de velden, alsjebl: Please look for my ring in the fields (it lies somewhere outside in Latium).
Find the ring outside in Latium.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik bouw een: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am building a new wall.
en::Win op de Via Latina (missie 2) en v: Win on the Via Latina (mission 2) and defeat four enemies on the road.
en::De nieuwe muur is klaar! Dank je wel: The new wall is finished! Thank you.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik hou van s: Greetings, leader {naam}! I love fast soldiers.
en::Heb een snelle soldaat (minstens 10: Have a fast soldier (at least 10 celeritas) and defeat five enemies on the coast.
en::Heb een soldaat met minstens 10 cele: Have a soldier with at least 10 celeritas.
en::Zoek de dichter op en win de eerste: Find the poet and win the first mission in Graecia.
en::Heeft de Pythia je gestuurd? Goed! I: Did the Pythia send you? Good! I will sing a song for you.
Win the first mission in Graecia.
en::Het orakel is waar. Dank je wel!: The oracle is true. Thank you!
en::Praat met Cassandra en versla zes vi: Talk to Cassandra and defeat six enemies in front of the walls.
en::Praat met Cassandra (de grot in Troi: Talk to Cassandra (the cave in Troia).
I see danger! Enemies are coming.
Defeat enemies in front of the walls.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Een amfoor wij: Greetings, guest {naam}! A jar of wine has gone missing.
en::Zoek de amfoor ergens buiten in Troj: Please look for the jar somewhere outside in Troy.
Find the jar of wine outside in Troy.
The jar of wine! Thank you.
en::Een enorme rots versperrt de weg. Ee: A huge boulder blocks the road. A strong soldier (hoplite or Spartan) can break it.
breaks the boulder! The road is open.
en::Een boom is omgevallen en versperrt: A tree has fallen and blocks the road. An engineer (builder) can clear it away.
clears the tree! The road is open.
en::Een vervloekt altaar versperrt de we: A cursed altar blocks the road. A priest (or mythical creature) can cleanse it.
cleanses the altar! The road is open.
en::Een verlaten legerplaats versperrt d: An abandoned army camp blocks the road. A centurion can lead the soldiers again.
en::voert de soldaten aan! De weg is ope: leads the soldiers! The road is open.
en::Hier zijn sporen. Een verkenner of r: There are tracks here. A scout or rider can follow them.
en::volgt de sporen en vindt een schat!: follows the tracks and finds a treasure!
en::Rome is gesloten! Vijanden belegeren: Rome is closed! Enemies are besieging Ardea. The city guards let nobody in while the army at Ardea is in trouble.
en::Ardea is verdedigd! De wachters stap: Ardea is defended! The guards step aside: Rome is open to you.
en::Een enorme eik is tijdens de storm o: A huge oak has fallen across the road to Gaul during the storm. Only strong men, like the gladiators from the arena of Rome, can drag it away.
en::De gladiatoren hebben de boom wegges: The gladiators have dragged the tree away. The road to Gaul is clear!
en::De grens met Germanië is gesloten. D: The border with Germania is closed. The Germans are fierce; the guards keep the border shut until Gaul is safe.
en::Alesia is gevallen en Gallië is veil: Alesia has fallen and Gaul is safe. The guards open the border to Germania.
en::Na een aardbeving ligt de weg naar L: After an earthquake the road to Laconia is full of boulders. Only when the monster of the labyrinth is defeated will the stonemasons dare to start.
en::De steenhouwers hebben de rotsblokke: The stonemasons have cleared the boulders. The road to Laconia is clear!
en::De brug naar Troje is dicht. De wach: The bridge to Troy is closed. The guards say: help at Sparta first, then you may pass.
en::Sparta is gered. De wachters laten d: Sparta is saved. The guards lower the bridge: the road to Troy is open.
en::De Amazones bewaken de bosweg naar T: The Amazons guard the forest road to Themiscyra. As long as Troy is threatened by the wooden horse, they let nobody through.
en::Troje is gered. De Amazones laten hu: Troy is saved. The Amazons lower their spears: Themiscyra is open to you.
en::De Perzische wachters sluiten de oos: The Persian guards close the eastern road. First the queen of the Amazons must be helped.
en::De koningin van de Amazones is gehol: The queen of the Amazons has been helped. The Persian guards let you through.
en::Een zandstorm blokkeert de kustweg n: A sandstorm blocks the coastal road to Egypt. It will only die down when the Persian heart is defeated.
en::De zandstorm is gaan liggen. De weg: The sandstorm has died down. The road to Egypt is clear!
en::De Egyptische wachters houden de kus: The Egyptian guards keep the coastal road to Africa closed until the pyramids are safe.
en::De piramiden zijn veilig. De wachter: The pyramids are safe. The guards open the coastal road to Africa.
en::Nu kan ik mijn weg kiezen (menu: Her: Now I can choose my path (menu: Heroes, Evolve).
en::Leider {naam}, de tijd is gekomen. I: Leader {naam}, the time has come. I am looking for my bow.
en::Versla acht vijanden aan de kust, zo: Defeat eight enemies on the coast, find Cassandra and defeat the Cyclops.
en::Versla vijanden aan de kust van Troj: Defeat enemies on the coast of Troy.
en::Praat met Cassandra (de grot in Troj: Talk to Cassandra (the cave in Troy).
en::Zoekt Odysseus zijn boog? De Cycloop: Is Odysseus looking for his bow? The Cyclops has it!
en::Versla de Cycloop (de grot in Troje): Defeat the Cyclops (the cave in Troy).
en::Leider {naam}, ik ben een boogschutt: Leader {naam}, I am an archer. I am looking for the arrow of Apollo.
en::Versla twaalf vijanden bij de Scaman: Defeat twelve enemies at the Scamander, capture three enemies and defeat the dragon (the cave in Graecia).
en::Versla de draak (de grot in Graecia): Defeat the dragon (the cave in Graecia).
en::De pijl van Apollo! Ik krijg ambrosi: The arrow of Apollo! I receive ambrosia.
en::Leider {naam}, ik ben een sluiper. I: Leader {naam}, I am a sneak. I am looking for new tricks.
en::Versla twaalf vijanden in de tunnel,: Defeat twelve enemies in the tunnel, capture three enemies and defeat the dragon (the cave in Graecia).
en::Mijn listen hebben gewonnen! Ik krij: My tricks have won! I receive ambrosia.
Ears of grain, lost from a cart.
A shard with a little posca left.
A bundle of fragrant herbs, still sweet-smelling.
A lost purse with travel money.
I came, I saw, I conquered.
Where it is good, there is my homeland.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Hier kun je ui: Greetings, guest {naam}! Here you can rest.
en::Je hebt vandaag al gerust. Kom morge: You have already rested today. Come back tomorrow!
en::Waar ga je jagen, leider {naam}?: Where are you going to hunt, leader {naam}?
en::Je hebt geen soldaat. Je vecht zelf,: You have no soldier. You fight yourself, leader!
en::De verslagen vijand zegt: \"Ik zal j: The defeated enemy says: "I will follow you, leader {naam}."
en::Wil je hem in het kamp opnemen?: Do you want to take him into the camp?
This gate is not open yet.
You do not have enough grain.
There has been enough training today.
en::Wil je deze soldaat eervol ontslaan?: Do you want to honourably discharge this soldier?
en::\"Gegroet, leider {naam}! Dit is jou: "Greetings, leader {naam}! This is your camp. Gather wood and bronze, improve the praetorium and go hunting in Latium."
en::\"Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik ben Aenea: "Greetings, guest {naam}! I am Aeneas. Enemies in the forest are a nuisance. Defeat three enemies in the forest and you will have my help."
en::\"Goed! Versla drie vijanden in het: "Good! Defeat three enemies in the forest."
en::\"Uitstekend, leider {naam}! Je hebt: "Excellent, leader {naam}! You have defeated three enemies. Thank you. I will come with you."
Choose a soldier and place him.
The hero comes to your heroum.
You do not have enough bronze.
en::Werf nieuwe soldaten bij de Dilectus: Recruit new soldiers at the Dilectus.
Log in to fight with your legion.
en::Vandaag is er geen legioen-evenement: There is no legion event today.
en::Het legioen komt samen! Is iedereen: The legion is gathering! Is everyone here?
You see tracks of a big man.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek heilig: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for holy water.
en::Daal af in de diepe grot (trap boven: Descend into the deep cave (stairs at the top) and bring the holy water.
en::Het heilige water! Dank je wel, leid: The holy water! Thank you, leader {naam}!
en::Romulus is op de Via. Zoek hem op!: Romulus is on the Via. Go and find him!
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ken jij Lati: Greetings, leader {naam}! Do you know Latin words?
I will give you five questions.
en::Vandaag heb je genoeg gedaan. Kom mo: You have done enough today. Come back tomorrow, leader {naam}!
en::Versla er drie en je krijgt een belo: Defeat three and you will receive a reward.
en::Latium: haal heilig water uit de die: Latium: fetch holy water from the deep cave (stairs at the top of the Specus Lupae) for the Hermit.
en::De verslagen vijand vlucht. Wil je e: The defeated enemy flees. Do you want an enemy in your camp? Capture him before he is defeated.
en::Gegroet, gast! De wolvin voedde eens: Greetings, guest! The she-wolf once fed Romulus and Remus.
en::In de grot in het westen wonen nog w: Wolves and fauns still live in the cave in the west. Do not go in without weapons!
en::Ik kijk naar de vogels. De adelaars: I watch the birds. Jupiter's eagles fly above the Capitol, but only by day.
en::De wolven van Mars wonen op het Mars: The wolves of Mars live on the Field of Mars, in the south and west.
en::En bij de graven, ten zuiden van de: And near the graves, south of the wall, the lemures roam at night.
en::Ik zing oude liederen. De wolven van: I sing old songs. The wolves of Mars lie hidden in the cave in the south.
en::Ga niet zonder wapens naar binnen!: Do not go in without weapons!
en::Het Hercynische woud is oud en dicht: The Hercynian Forest is old and dense.
en::In de grot in het oosten slaapt een: A dragon sleeps in the cave in the east. Do not wake it!
en::Aan de oostkust zingen 's nachts de: On the east coast the Sirens sing at night, and the Harpies torment Phineus.
en::In de olijfgaarden in het westen lei: In the olive groves in the west Bacchus leads the satyrs; there the spring of Pegasus lies hidden.
en::In de stad in het oosten zijn mieren: In the city in the east ants have been turned into people, and dragon's teeth lie in a field.
en::Sparta houdt van bergen. Op de berg: Sparta loves mountains. Griffins nest on Mount Taygetus.
en::In de stad in het oosten zwerven de: In the city in the east the Spartoi roam, born from teeth.
en::Bij de Scamander, in het westen, lig: By the Scamander, in the west, a spring of nymphs lies hidden.
en::In het oosten bewaken de Cyclopen de: In the east the Cyclopes guard the old walls.
en::Op het strand spelen de Nereïden, en: On the beach the Nereids play, and sea horses swim at the mouth of the Scamander.
en::De Dryaden wonen in de heilige eik,: The Dryads live in the sacred oak, in the north; the centaurs in the meadow, in the south.
en::Gevleugelde paarden grazen in een an: Winged horses graze in another meadow, and the Oreads dance on the mountain.
en::Harpijen nestelen op de oostelijke k: Harpies nest on the eastern cliffs. Watch out!
en::In de bergen in het westen nestelen: Griffins nest in the mountains in the west.
en::In de rode rots in het noorden is ee: In the red rock in the north there is a crevice where snakes hide.
en::Bij zonsopgang bezoekt de Feniks Hel: At sunrise the Phoenix visits Heliopolis.
en::Je ziet hem alleen overdag, in het n: You only see him by day, in the north and east.
en::Aan de oostkust zingen 's nachts de: On the east coast the Sirens sing at night.
en::Pas op! Zeelieden worden misleid doo: Watch out! Sailors are misled by their song.
en::Het is marktdag! Koop iets, gast!: It is market day! Buy something, guest!
en::Deze soldaat werkt in het kamp. Roep: This soldier is working in the camp. Call him back first (menu: Labor).
en::Een soldaat die traint kan niet werk: A soldier who is training cannot work.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek mareta: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for mistletoe.
en::Ga diep het grot in en breng de mare: Go deep into the cave and bring the mistletoe.
en::Haal de maretak voor de druïde uit h: Fetch the mistletoe for the druid from the deepest part of the cave.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek mijn d: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for my thread.
en::Ga diep het labyrint in en breng de: Go deep into the labyrinth and bring Ariadne's thread.
en::Haal de draad van Ariadne voor Daeda: Fetch Ariadne's thread for Daedalus from the deepest part of the labyrinth.
The ships sail across the sea.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek de hei: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for the sacred scarab.
en::Ga diep de piramide in en breng de s: Go deep into the pyramid and bring the scarab.
en::Haal de heilige scarabee voor de pri: Fetch the sacred scarab for the priest from the deepest part of the pyramid.
en::De farao wordt in de piramide begrav: The pharaoh is buried in the pyramid.
Cleopatra is the queen of Egypt.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek mijn l: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for my lamb.
en::Ga diep de grot in en breng mijn lam: Go deep into the cave and bring my lamb back.
en::Haal het verdwaalde lam voor de herd: Fetch the lost lamb for the shepherd from the deepest part of the cave.
en::De koning van Sparta gaat naar de oo: The king of Sparta goes to war.
en::De moeder stuurt haar zoon naar de s: The mother sends her son into battle.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek mijn p: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for my arrow.
en::Ga diep de tunnel in en breng de pij: Go deep into the tunnel and bring the arrow of Apollo.
en::Haal de pijl van Apollo voor Cassand: Fetch Apollo's arrow for Cassandra from the deepest part of the tunnel.
The Greeks are building a wooden horse.
Priam is the king of Troy.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek mijn d: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for my drinking horn.
en::Ga diep de grot in en breng mijn hoo: Go deep into the cave and bring my horn back.
en::Haal de drinkhoorn voor de oude jage: Fetch the drinking horn for the old hunter from the deepest part of the cave.
The forest is big and dark.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek de gor: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for the belt of Hippolyta.
en::Ga diep de grot in en breng de gorde: Go deep into the cave and bring the belt.
en::Haal de gordel van Hippolyta voor de: Fetch Hippolyta's belt for the priestess from the deepest part of the cave.
en::Hippolyta is de koningin van de Amaz: Hippolyta is the queen of the Amazons.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek het he: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for the sacred fire.
en::Ga diep het graf in en breng het hei: Go deep into the tomb and bring the sacred fire.
en::Het heilige vuur! Dank je wel, leide: The sacred fire! Thank you, leader {naam}!
en::Haal het heilige vuur voor de magiër: Fetch the sacred fire for the magus from the deepest part of the royal tomb.
The king of the Persians is great.
The magi guard the sacred fire.
The riders race across the field.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Ik zoek mijn o: Greetings, guest {naam}! I am looking for my elephant tusk.
en::Ga diep de grot in en breng mijn oli: Go deep into the cave and bring my elephant tusk back.
en::Mijn olifantstand! Dank je wel, leid: My elephant tusk! Thank you, leader {naam}!
en::Haal de olifantstand voor de olifant: Fetch the elephant tusk for the elephant leader from the deepest part of the cave.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Vertaal Lati: Greetings, leader {naam}! Translate Latin sentences! Five questions.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik heb een s: Greetings, leader {naam}! I have a strong fighter.
en::Vandaag heb je hem verslagen. Kom mo: Today you have defeated him. Come back tomorrow!
en::Durf je tegen hem te vechten? Wie wi: Do you dare to fight him? The winner gets a reward.
en::Ik ben de bewaker van deze plek. Hie: I am the guardian of this place. Here I stay!
en::Durf je met mij te vechten?: Do you dare to fight me?
en::Een snelle vijand. Hij rent veel sne: A fast enemy. He runs much faster than the rest, but has few life points.
en::Een zware krijger: langzaam, veel le: A heavy warrior: slow, with many life points and armour (your damage is 20% lower). If he breaks through, it costs 2 lives instead of 1.
en::Een schilddrager: vijanden in zijn b: A shield-bearer: enemies near him take 35% less damage.
en::Een genezer: elke 2 seconden herstel: A healer: every 2 seconds he restores 6% of the life points of enemies near him (an enemy can regain at most 60% of its life points this way).
en::Het waait hard: alle vijanden lopen: It is windy: all enemies walk 15% faster.
en::Het is nacht: je soldaten hebben 25%: It is night: your soldiers have 25% less range.
en::Het regent: boogschutters doen 30% m: It is raining: archers deal 30% less damage.
en::Het is erg heet: cavalerie doet 30%: It is very hot: cavalry deals 30% less damage.
en::Het is koud: al je soldaten schieten: It is cold: all your soldiers shoot 20% slower.
en::De linie is smal: je mag maximaal 5: The line is narrow: you may place at most 5 soldiers.
en::Helden mogen deze missie niet meedoe: Heroes may not take part in this mission.
en::Boogschutters mogen deze missie niet: Archers may not take part in this mission.
en::Na een golf krijg je geen gunst om u: After a wave you get no favour to choose from.
en::Infanterie vertraagt vijanden met 25: Infantry slows enemies by 25% as long as an archer stands within 3 tiles. This gives the archer more time to shoot.
en::Cavalerie doet 50% extra schade aan: Cavalry deals 50% extra damage to enemies that have only half of their life points left.
en::Een boogschutter binnen het bereik v: An archer within range of a support unit gets 15% extra range, on top of the support unit's normal buff.
en::Tijdens een golf kun je twee bevelen: During a wave you can give two commands. Impete! (Attack!): for 8 seconds +25% damage and 30% faster attacks. State! (Hold!): for 4 seconds all enemies move at 40% speed. Each command costs 1 energy (⚡): you start with 1 and gain 1 after every wave and after every 15 enemies defeated (max. 3).
The Roman senate elects a consul.
en::De consul houdt een toespraak op het: The consul gives a speech in the Forum.
en::De leider voert de soldaten naar het: The leader leads the soldiers to the camp.
The ship arrives at the harbour.
The water flows in the river.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! De senaat ro: Greetings, leader {naam}! The senate is calling you.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! De thermen sta: Greetings, guest {naam}! The baths are open to you.
en::Je hebt vandaag al gebaad. Kom morge: You have already bathed today. Come back tomorrow!
en::Wil je een bad nemen?: Do you want to take a bath?
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik heb een s: Greetings, leader {naam}! I have a strong gladiator.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Het is hier do: Greetings, guest {naam}! It is dark here. I am looking for my oil lamp.
en::Daal af in de diepe catacomben (trap: Descend into the deep catacombs (stairs at the top) and bring my lamp back.
en::Ik ben een Larva, een spook. Hier sl: I am a Larva, a ghost. Here I sleep!
en::Durf je mij wakker te maken?: Do you dare to wake me?
en::Roma: haal de lamp van de Custos uit: Roma: fetch the Custos' lamp from the deep catacombs (stairs at the top of the first cave).
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Mijn schaap is: Greetings, guest {naam}! My sheep has disappeared.
en::Zoek het schaap op de velden en vers: Look for the sheep in the fields and defeat three enemies in the field.
Find the sheep outside in Latium.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Vijanden val: Greetings, leader {naam}! Enemies are attacking the road.
en::Versla zes vijanden op de weg en van: Defeat six enemies on the road and capture one.
en::Uitstekend, leider {naam}! De weg is: Excellent, leader {naam}! The road is safe.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Mijn geit is z: Greetings, guest {naam}! My goat has gone missing.
en::Zoek de geit en versla vier vijanden: Look for the goat and defeat four enemies in the olive groves.
Find the goat outside in Graecia.
Defeat enemies in the olive groves.
en::Ach, gast {naam}! Mijn zoon is verdw: Oh, guest {naam}! My son has disappeared.
en::Zoek mijn zoon, alsjeblieft (hij is: Please look for my son (he is somewhere outside in Troy).
Find the boy outside in Troy.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Vijanden val: Greetings, leader {naam}! Enemies are attacking the walls.
en::Versla zes vijanden voor de muren en: Defeat six enemies in front of the walls and win the first mission in Troy.
Win the first mission in Troy.
en::Ach, leider {naam}! Rovers hebben mi: Oh, leader {naam}! Robbers have stolen my cart.
en::Versla zes vijanden in het bos en zo: Defeat six enemies in the forest and find my goods.
en::Zoek de gestolen waren buiten in Gal: Find the stolen goods outside in Gallia.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! Het heilige va: Greetings, guest {naam}! The sacred vessel has gone missing.
en::Zoek het heilige vat en versla vijf: Find the sacred vessel and defeat five enemies at the Nile.
en::Zoek het heilige vat buiten in Aegyp: Find the sacred vessel outside in Aegyptus.
The sacred vessel! The gods thank you.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! De koning va: Greetings, leader {naam}! The king of the Persians is calling you.
en::Vijanden vallen mijn rijk aan. Versl: Enemies are attacking my kingdom. Defeat eight enemies and win the first mission in Persia.
Win the first mission in Persia.
en::Mijn rijk is veilig. Dank je wel, le: My kingdom is safe. Thank you, leader {naam}!
en::Ach, gast {naam}! Mijn zoon is gladi: Oh, guest {naam}! My son is a gladiator.
en::Vraag het aan de lanista: vecht mijn: Ask the lanista: does my son fight well? Then defeat five enemies in the arena.
en::Praat met de lanista (de gladiatoren: Talk to the lanista (the gladiator school in Roma).
en::De zoon van die oude vrouw? Hij is s: That old woman's son? He is strong and fights well.
My son is strong! Thank you.
en::Ach, leider {naam}! Mijn paard is we: Oh, leader {naam}! My horse has run away.
en::Zoek het paard, vraag het aan de bou: Find the horse, ask the builder and defeat five enemies on the road. Then I will give you a horse as a gift.
Find the horse outside in Latium.
en::Vraag het aan de bouwer (Latium): hi: Ask the builder (Latium): he repairs the harness.
en::Gaat het paard terug naar de koopman: Is the horse going back to the merchant? Good! I have made new harness.
en::Mijn paard! Ik geef jou een paard, l: My horse! I give you a horse, leader {naam}.
en::Nu kun je snel rijden! (knop 🐎 links: Now you can ride fast! (button 🐎 top left in the world)
en::Pas op, gast {naam}! Wolven vallen m: Watch out, guest {naam}! Wolves are attacking my sheep.
en::Versla zes vijanden in het bos en zo: Defeat six enemies in the forest and find the lost sheep.
Find the sheep outside in Germania.
en::Gegroet, gast! Ik ben een jager. Lat: Greetings, guest! I am a hunter. Let's fight!
en::Ik bewaak hier de weg. Vecht je met: I guard the road here. Will you fight me?
en::Ik wil je kracht op de proef stellen: I want to test your strength. Come on!
en::Vandaag heb je mij verslagen. Kom mo: Today you have defeated me. Come back tomorrow for a rematch!
en::Goed zo! Nu gaan we vechten (extra g: Well done! Now we fight (extra glory if you win).
en::Niet goed. Maar laten we toch vechte: Not good. But let's fight anyway.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Aenea: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Aeneas. Your camp is still empty.
en::Bouw eerst het Praetorium, je hoofdg: First build the Praetorium, your main building. Tap on the grass where the entrance should go: green is allowed, red is not.
en::Uitstekend! Zet nu meer gebouwen nee: Excellent! Now place more buildings: a Lignatio (wood), a Metallum (bronze), a Valetudinarium (healing) and Contubernia (barracks).
en::Hout en brons krijg je van mij, alle: I give you wood and bronze, everything is free. Keep the paths and the gates clear!
Task 1: place your Praetorium. Tap on a free grass tile where the entrance should go.
en::Gegroet, leider {naam}! Ik ben Aenea: Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Aeneas. Your camp is new.
en::Je hebt soldaten nodig. Ik geef je e: You need soldiers. I will give you one.
en::Goed gekozen! Deze soldaat is van jo: Well chosen! This soldier is yours.
en::Vang nu nog een soldaat. Ga door de: Now capture another soldier. Go through the porta decumana to Latium. Weaken an enemy and use Capere to capture him.
en::Verdedig nu het kamp. Ga door de por: Now defend the camp. Go through the porta praetoria and win the battle.
en::Plaats je soldaten (tik op een solda: Place your soldiers (tap a soldier, then a free tile) and defeat the enemies!
en::Uitstekend, leider {naam}! Je hebt h: Excellent, leader {naam}! You have defended the camp.
en::Nu weet je hoe je jaagt, werft en ve: Now you know how to hunt, recruit and fight.
en::Zoek nu helden en verken nieuwe regi: Now look for heroes and explore new regions. See you!
Task 1: capture a second soldier. Go through the porta decumana (at the top), weaken the enemy with your moves and tap "Capere" (defeating him makes him flee).
Task 2: win the first battle. Go through the porta praetoria (right), choose "Defensio castrorum" and place your soldiers.
Here you see all soldiers and heroes.
en::In de regio's staan kisten en opdrac: In the regions there are chests and tasks.
en::Je krijgt kaarten! Ze geven bonussen: You get cards! They give bonuses.
en::Vandaag trek je er gratis één. Ook q: Today you draw one for free. Quests also give draws.
en::Open het menu ☰ en kies Tabulae. Tre: Open the menu ☰ and choose Tabulae. If you draw a card twice, it gets stars; the odds are in the guide.
en::Na elke golf kun je een gunst kiezen: After every wave you can choose a favour.
en::Soldaten die in de tent rusten, lere: Soldiers resting in the tent still learn along.
en::Je krijgt het Contubernium! Soldaten: You get the Contubernium! Soldiers who do not fight get a share of the experience (menu: Milites).
en::Je hebt er maar vier. Kies verstandi: You only have four. Choose wisely! (menu: Milites or Heroes)
The builder is looking for wood and bronze.
en::Bouw samen met hem! Gebouwen geven d: Build together with him! Buildings give something every day.
The teacher wants to play with you.
en::Je kunt soldaten met elkaar vergelij: You can compare soldiers with each other.
That is how you choose the best.
en::Gegroet, gast {naam}! De tempel van: Greetings, guest {naam}! The temple of Jupiter is open.
en::Je hebt vandaag al geofferd. Kom mor: You have already made an offering today. Come back tomorrow!
en::Wil je een offer brengen aan Iuppite: Do you want to make an offering to Jupiter?
The grain is good this year.
en::De grond is goed, maar het werk is z: The soil is good, but the work is hard.
My children are playing in the field.
en::Ik bak brood. Wil je brood, gast?: I bake bread. Do you want bread, guest?
There is peace. I am happy.
en::Ik wil ook soldaat worden!: I want to become a soldier too!
I am playing with my friends.
en::Vroeger was ik soldaat, maar nu ben: I used to be a soldier, but now I am old.
I have seen a lot in my life.
en::Luister, gast: wijsheid is beter dan: Listen, guest: wisdom is better than gold.
I am a merchant. I have many goods.
I bring wine and bread to the city.
en::De weg is lang, maar het geld is goe: The road is long, but the money is good.
I work with my mother in the field.
en::Ik vereer de goden en vraag om vrede: I worship the gods and ask for peace.
You must pray in the temple.
en::Ik ben een wachter. Ik bewaar de vre: I am a guard. I keep the peace.
I am looking for brave soldiers.
en::Ik ben de koning. Mijn rijk is groot: I am the king. My kingdom is great.
en::De vrede van mijn rijk is mij dierba: The peace of my kingdom is dear to me.
I take care of my sheep.
en::Er is een wolf in het bos! Pas op, g: There is a wolf in the forest! Watch out, guest!
The sun is hot. I am looking for water.
The walls of Troy are high.
The forests of Gaul are big.
The Forum is full of people.
en::Het bos is dicht. Pas op!: The forest is dense. Watch out!
The Amazons ride across the fields.
The granary gives grain every day.
The sawmill gives wood every day.
The mine gives bronze every day.
en::Wil je mij hout en brons geven?: Do you want to give me wood and bronze?
You do not have enough yet.
The soldiers sleep in the camp.
The riders come to the gate.
en::Ardea wordt belegerd! De vijanden be: Ardea is under siege! The enemies are storming the walls.
Ardea is free! We thank you.
Now Rome is open to you.
en::Alesia wordt belegerd. De honger dru: Alesia is under siege. Hunger is pressing us.
en::Er is vrede. Alesia is gevallen, maa: There is peace. Alesia has fallen, but we are alive.
en::De herinnering aan Thermopylae blijf: The memory of Thermopylae lives on.
